purpose: Test whether existing E36 root-action observations can support an independent continuation-stream check of action-return direction; no new game or learning experiment.
single_hypothesis: A root-action preference estimated from one set of independent external policy streams retains positive return advantage in a separate set under the same frozen continuation policy.
selection: Use all original 192 fit and 64 label-holdout families and their original natural root. No later node search, collector selection, return filter, replacement or pooling.
action_pair: Greedy collecting-policy action and highest-probability different legal action, ties by original menu index. Zero probability means unsupported.
split: Repeats 0..3 discovery and 4..7 confirmation. Greedy repeat -1 is a replay control, never an independent stochastic observation.
signal_analysis: Only if coverage passes, require a separate review of an immutable analysis implementation before reading discovery/confirmation contrasts; no model or new rollout follows automatically. Coverage failure closes this archive-only implementation, not the scientific hypothesis.
limits: Different streams choose different observed actions; these are not forced common-random-number pairs.
Historical simulator/model and already exposed families; not current-runtime or unseen performance.
This coverage protocol makes no population effect or policy success claim.
